'''Avorr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Pureblood]] who was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], where he could be found on [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Avorr appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He is involved in the [[Sith Warrior]] class missions "A Sith Lord's Rise" and "Fanning the Flames," which are the ending missions for Chapters 1 and 2 of the class storyline respectively and see players visit Avorr&mdash;who does not speak&mdash;to receive a small reward.<ref name="TOR" />
